item.title: About Me
item.description:
I’m a 5th semester Computer Science student at FAST NUCES, Peshawar. I focus on cybersecurity, systems programming and Linux. I’m learning how Linux kernel development works by sending patches to the mailing list, and I build tools along the way, including radiq, a radial app launcher that’s published on the AUR.

Experience
#

  • Cybersecurity Trainee, IPICH Completed a one-month intensive national cybersecurity training program (Cybersecurity & Digital Defense track). Covered web penetration testing, Kali Linux tools, HTTP methods and practical offensive security techniques.

  • CATCH_VR Summer School, GIK Institute Hands-on IoT lab sessions, AR/VR and digital twins. With a team of five I built GIKIreasure Hunt, a location-based AR treasure hunt on the GIKI campus using Unity, AR Foundation and GPS.
